Apologies if this has been asked before, I couldn't find it on a
search.

The mummies brought into play by Spell of Life lose the card text card
tex of the original vampire card, right? For example, mummy
Nakhthorheb cannot untap during minion phases, and wouldn't have +1
strength, correct?

Spell of Life [LotN:C]
Cardtype: Action

Clan: Follower of Set

+1 stealth action.
Put this card in play. Only one Spell of Life may be played each turn.
You may burn five Spells of Life to put up to five vampires from your
uncontrolled region in play. Each represents a unique mummy ally with
life equal to capacity, 1 bleed and 2 strength who can enter combat
with a minion as a (D) action.

jase

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
jason...@iinet.net.au wrote:
> Apologies if this has been asked before, I couldn't find it on a
> search.
>
> The mummies brought into play by Spell of Life lose the card text card
> tex of the original vampire card, right? For example, mummy
> Nakhthorheb cannot untap during minion phases, and wouldn't have +1
> strength, correct?

Correct. The crypt card's text does not apply. Spell of Life uses only the crypt
card's name for uniqueness (and, briefly, capacity to make starting life). The
crypt card's clan and Disciplines are also ignored.

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/fd1518b5bd58b116
